data.name: HostKeyMismatch
data.value: The SSH server key ({0}) does not match the fingerprint saved in the connection ({1}). There may be another server in the way: check with whoever administers the server (ssh-keygen -lf). If the key really changed, enter the new one in "Host fingerprint", in Edit connection.

data.name: EncryptedKeyWithoutPassphrase
data.value: The SSH tunnel private key is encrypted, and this connection does not have its passphrase. Enter it to connect.

data.name: WrongPassphrase
data.value: The passphrase does not open the SSH tunnel private key. Check the passphrase and try again.

data.name: SshPasswordMissing
data.value: The SSH tunnel password is not saved in this connection. Connect to it and enter the password when Prism asks: without "Save credentials", it stays only in memory until the connection is disconnected.

data.name: ProxyPasswordMissing
data.value: The proxy password is not saved in this connection. Connect to it and enter the password when Prism asks: without "Save credentials", it stays only in memory until the connection is disconnected.

data.name: PrivateKeyPathRequired
data.value: Enter the SSH private key path.

data.name: SocksInvalidResponse
data.value: Invalid response from the SOCKS5 proxy server.

data.name: SocksCredentialsRefused
data.value: The SOCKS5 proxy refused the user or password.

data.name: SocksMethodRefused
data.value: The SOCKS5 proxy did not accept the authentication method.

data.name: SocksConnectFailed
data.value: The SOCKS5 proxy could not connect to the destination (code {0}).

data.name: SocksAddressTypeInvalid
data.value: Invalid address type in the SOCKS5 proxy response.
